notes.title: Fantasy Creature Jigsaw 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Thanks for your support! Your feedback has been a huge help in shaping this update. We've made some substantial improvements to the game and would love to hear what you think, so please feel free to leave a review or comment in the discussions.



 20 new puzzles across 4 categories added


 Existing puzzles upscaled and improved


 Hard mode added for puzzling without the puzzle shadow


 Added Gold, Silver & Bronzes badges for beating par times in the puzzles


 Performance improvement when generating puzzle pieces


 General UI upgrades



Thanks all!
